description: This source file defines a Swift class `GatewayDiscoveryModel` responsible for discovering and managing gateway services over a local network and wide-area network, using Bonjour/mDNS and other discovery methods. It includes data structures for gateways and local identities, methods for starting/stopping discovery, processing discovered services, and resolving service addresses. The class supports filtering local gateways, deduplicating results, and handling asynchronous background tasks for network discovery.

classes.name: GatewayDiscoveryModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for network gateway discovery and management, including initializing discovery browsers, handling network results, resolving services, and maintaining gateway list state.

classes.name: ResolvedGatewayService
classes.description: Data structure representing a resolved network service with its TXT record, hostname, and port.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: Helper class that manages resolving a specific network service (via DNS-SD / Bonjour) and calls a completion handler upon resolution or failure.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins network service discovery by creating and starting Bonjour browsers for configured domains.

methods.name: refreshWideAreaFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate wide-area discovery beacon scan within a specified timeout.

methods.name: refreshTailscaleServeFallbackNow
methods.description: Performs an immediate Tailscale Serve gateway discovery within a specified timeout.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops all ongoing network discovery activities and clears internal state.

methods.name: updateGateways
methods.description: Analyzes current discovery results, resolving service addresses as needed, to update the list of gateways.

methods.name: ensureServiceResolution
methods.description: Initiates DNS-SD resolution for a network service if not already resolved or pending.

methods.name: parseGatewayTXT
methods.description: Parses a TXT record dictionary into a GatewayTXT struct with proper data types.
